profile.headline: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary: Passionate Software Developer seeking new challenges and opportunities.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Received company-wide We Deliver award for delivering core platform features including order validation, notification preferences, and streamlined cart interface.
● Developed full-stack features for our user-facing React application utilizing GraphQL API and PostgreSQL database, enhancing user experience and application functionality.
● Led implementation of user notification preferences system, creating end-to-end functionality from api design to front-end user interface.
● Built on an accessible UI component library with React Aria, establishing reusable building blocks for platform-wide development and ensuring WCAG compliance.
● Heavily involved in product discovery, planning, and implementation of multiple cross-quarter initiatives.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked in a team of two in developing a live cloud-based service to facilitate the full process of laboratory
analyses from start to finish.
● Developed features in the React front-end and C# .Net Framework business logic, enhancing application
performance and user experience.
● Managed Azure services including Web App Services, Batch Accounts, Blob Storage, Container Registry,
and Compute Gallery.
● Optimized API calls to reduce page load times, improving application responsiveness by 50% in certain
areas.
● Collaborated closely with the client to address specific issues and improve product functionality.
● Practiced Kanban methodologies.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Microsoft Azure · React.js · .NET Framework · Identity Server

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.locationName: King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Maintain and support an EDI system in Oracle, which involves troubleshooting and resolving complex issues within the existing codebase.

Collaborate with EDI Analysts to understand requirements and develop new reports using Oracle.

Act as the primary point of contact for handling tickets and providing timely solutions to ensure smooth EDI operations.

Maintain and enhance the C# interface for the EDI system, ensuring it remains functional and efficient.

Proactively identify and fix bugs to improve system reliability and performance.

Offer valuable insights and advice to the company's management on modernizing programming and development methodologies.

positions.title: Software Developer P2
positions.description:
• Worked with a small team of software developers to develop and maintain four live games supporting hundreds of concurrent users, each with a self-hosted web interface, application on Facebook, and mobile application supported by iOS, Android, and FireOS.
• Developed backend game logic in our PHP framework, utilizing caching layers to relieve load on MySQL and MongoDB databases. 
• Interfaced with our producers, creative team, statisticians, and player success representatives frequently to improve product quality and user experience during development.
• Practiced Kanban methodologies.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · REST APIs · MongoDB · MySQL · Cordova · PHP

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
●​ Worked with a small team of software developers to develop and maintain four live games supporting hundreds of concurrent users, each with a self-hosted web interface, application on Facebook, and mobile application supported by iOS, Android, and FireOS.

●​ Developed backend game logic in our PHP framework, utilizing caching layers to relieve load on MySQL and MongoDB databases.

●​ Monitored and evaluated impact of major releases by reviewing mobile-app data from Firebase, framework performance data via Grafana, and filtering on logging with Graylog and Sentry services.

●​ Interfaced with our producers, creative team, statisticians, and player success representatives frequently to improve product quality and user experience during development.

●​ Practiced Kanban methodologies.

positions.title: Software Implementation Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed numerous C# .NET scripts to assist in safely mass importing client data to the application database.
• Worked with a team of five implementers to configure, maintain, and support eight client sites with 26 application servers simultaneously.
• Assisted in providing 24-hour on-site customer support during a major go-live release to a production factory.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
●​ Worked with a small team of software developers to develop and improve software for data entry, extraction, and analysis of pediatric patient data while practicing agile methodologies.

●​ Provided numerous patient-related reports by writing SQL queries run against an MSSQL database.
●​ Improved performance on a data migration process via developing custom SSIS packages, creating and configuring an additional staging SQL Server database, and implementing the principle of least privilege in regard to access to those databases.

●​ Interfaced with our clinical resource team, statisticians, and end-users frequently to improve product quality and user experience during development.

●​ Resolved numerous bug fixes and feature requests to our JavaScript front end, C# .NET Framework api, and MSSQL databases.

●​ Provided technical support and training to nurses and data collectors.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Worked with a team of software developers to develop and improve software for entry, extraction, and analysis of pediatric patient data.
•	Developed JavaScript user interface and .NET api for displaying and filtering graphical data utilizing Hicharts.
•	Interfaced with our clinical resource team, statisticians, and end-users frequently to improve product quality and user experience during development.
•	Resolved numerous bug fixes and feature requests to our front end, api, and sql databases.
•	Practiced agile development methodologies.
•	Provided technical support and training to nurses and data collectors.

positions.title: Presales Engineer
positions.description:
•	Built custom demonstrations of enterprise content management software for potential clients.
•	Provided technical support to value added resellers and users for Laserfiche software.
•	Programmed custom Laserfiche SDK scripts in .Net and C# to assist with value added reseller’s Laserfiche systems.

positions.title: Lead Technician
positions.description:
•	Provided phone support to clients who need assistance with computer issues and troubleshooting those issues.  
•	Worked with students and other technicians to evaluate and determine computer issues for drop in service.
•	Supervised shifts of about 2-3 technicians, making sure that computer issues are handled properly and efficiently.

positions.title: Software Developer & Graphic Designer
positions.description:
•	Worked in a team of six computer science students to develop software designed to help doctors survey patients to track their recovery.  
•	Used Xcode 5 to develop software for an iOS 7 application. 
•	Used Android Studio to develop software for an Android application. 
•	Programmed in Objective C and Java. 
•	Designed app concepts, posters, logos, and splash screens using Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator. 
•	Designed several different CSS style sheets for the web end of our application.

company.name: University of Vermont, Alliance iOS, Android and Web Application

positions.title: Supervisor
positions.description:
•	Supervised shifts of around 5-10 movie theater employees.
•	Handled and counted money in box office drawers.
•	Assisted in organization of birthday parties and various events that the theater held.
•	Redesigned the Essex Cinemas application design and layout.

projects.title: Alliance
projects.description: Our group designed, implemented, and troubleshooted both an iOS and Android mobile application, as well as a Web platform. Intended to provide real time feedback to doctors and researchers, the app asks patients about their current mood throughout the day, and forwards their responses to a secure server. The web platform is designed to detect negative trends in patient response and immediately alert the patient's doctor, providing real time intervention. This app was built with a dynamic framework model, allowing doctors to tailor the questions based on the needs of each individual patient. We are currently working to expand this package to a variety of professions as a surveying platform to assist in the improvement of daily routines of many professions.
